content: I am worried about my daughter. She hasn't made a decision about college.
Don't worry, that's just part of being a teenager.
I don't actually mind that. But she disagrees with me about everything.
You should encourage her to make up her mind by herself instead of trying to tell her what to do and what not to do.
But I just want to give her some tips.
She can make her own decision. Believe her!
Take it easy. Everything will be OK.
